stem: 一位欧盟信托和公司服务提供商的分析师在查看一位客户的财务报表和详细的分类账时,发现了一些异常活动.该客户从事机械进出口业务.哪项交易指标需要进一步上报给合规官？

options.A: 向位于税收优惠地区的外国公司支付公司秘书常年顾问费
options.B: 海外虚拟办公室服务的支付
options.C: 母公司向子公司提供的用于支付机械设备运输费用的公司间贷款
options.D: 向在外国司法管辖区设立的无关联公司及服务提供商支付咨询费

stem_en: An EU trust and company service provider analyst notices some unusual activity while looking through a customer's financial statements and detailed general ledger. The customer is in the business of importing and exporting machinery. Which transaction indicator warrants further escalation to the compliance officer?

options_en.A: The payment of company secretarial retainer fees to a foreign company in a tax-efficient jurisdiction
options_en.B: The payment of virtual office services overseas
options_en.C: Inter-company loans from the holding company to the subsidiary company to finance the shipment of machinery
options_en.D: The payment of consultancy fees to unrelated companies and service providers established in a foreign jurisdiction
